shared_finding: ActiveAssembly's current unconditional conflict-first reservation has a synthetic starvation counterexample under hard context budgets. Conflict visibility remains mandatory, but conflict allocation must be treated as an explicit tested scheduling tradeoff rather than an unbounded priority rule.

frank.delta: Keep bounded ActiveAssembly OPEN; add conflict-budget scheduling as an explicit architecture parameter/discriminator. Do not adopt a numeric quota from synthetic evidence.

harness.delta: Add frozen-trace conflict-density/budget sweeps and downstream task/GWT/4B causal-use outcomes before changing H1 selection policy.

gwt.delta: Workspace competition must receive an Assembly whose conflict reservation cannot silently consume the complete cognitive budget; compare conflict visibility against general task evidence under matched budgets.

hyperposition.delta: Preserving alternatives need not imply materializing every alternative into the same bounded active slice. Test grouped/latent alternatives plus selective expansion against full pair reservation.

claygraph.delta: The finding mirrors the RAB stability/plasticity frontier: strong preservation gates reduce one failure mode while increasing adaptation/selection cost. Provenance diversity and conflict visibility remain separate from absolute slot priority.

unifieddb.delta: Persist claim-group/conflict/provenance identities and re-expansion references so alternative allocation policies are replayable without changing canonical truth state.

claycode.delta: Existing semantics should first express conflict groups, budgets, policy identity and receipts. No core syntax change is justified by this counterexample.

emergenz.delta: Selection allocation changes causal exposure of evidence and is an experimental confound; it is not an emergence score or consciousness evidence.

clayresearch.delta: Fuse conflict-budget allocation with retrieval diversity, stability/plasticity and adaptive-compute research; preserve compact retrieval/event-driven orchestration as the strongest simpler baseline.
